class.name: OksKernel
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/kernel.hpp). The root object of the OKS in-memory database: it loads schema and data files, owns every OksClass and OksObject, and exposes the git-backed configuration repository. Most methods are thread-safe; those prefixed k_ are not.

attribute.name: verbose_mode
attribute.description: C++ bool. get_verbose_mode()/set_verbose_mode(bool); env override OKS_KERNEL_VERBOSE.

attribute.name: silence_mode
attribute.description: C++ bool. get_silence_mode()/set_silence_mode(bool); env override OKS_KERNEL_SILENCE.

attribute.name: profiling_mode
attribute.description: C++ bool. get_profiling_mode()/set_profiling_mode(bool); env override OKS_KERNEL_PROFILING.

attribute.name: allow_duplicated_classes_mode
attribute.description: C++ bool. Tolerate the same class name arriving from two schema files.

attribute.name: allow_duplicated_objects_mode
attribute.description: C++ bool. Tolerate the same object id appearing twice.

attribute.name: repository_root
attribute.description: C++ std::string, from the TDAQ_DB_REPOSITORY environment variable. Static accessor get_repository_root().

attribute.name: user_repository_root
attribute.description: C++ std::string, from TDAQ_DB_USER_REPOSITORY. get_user_repository_root()/set_user_repository_root(path, version).

attribute.name: repository_version
attribute.description: C++ std::string. The checked-out configuration version; selectors are hash:<sha>, tag:<tag> or date:<timestamp>.

attribute.name: repository_update_type
attribute.description: C++ enum RepositoryUpdateType, passed to update_repository().

attribute.name: number_of_classes
attribute.description: C++ size_t number_of_classes(); size of classes().

attribute.name: number_of_objects
attribute.description: C++ size_t number_of_objects(); size of objects().

relationship.name: SchemaFiles
relationship.description: OksFile::Map schema_files(): every loaded *.schema.xml.

relationship.name: DataFiles
relationship.description: OksFile::Map data_files(): every loaded *.data.xml.

relationship.name: Classes
relationship.description: OksClass::Map classes(): every class known to this kernel.

relationship.name: Objects
relationship.description: OksObject::Set objects(): every object bound in this kernel.

relationship.name: RepositoryVersions
relationship.description: get_repository_versions(): git history of the configuration repository.

method.name: find_class
method.description: Look a class up by name. Returns nullptr when the schema does not define it; this is the schema-grounding check the agent must run before serialising a query.

method-implementation.prototype: OksClass * find_class(const std::string&) const

method.name: load_schema
method.description: Load an OKS schema file (class definitions) and any file it includes.

method-implementation.prototype: OksFile * load_schema(const std::string& name, const OksFile * parent = 0)

method.name: load_data
method.description: Load an OKS data file (concrete objects) and bind its references.

method-implementation.prototype: OksFile * load_data(const std::string& name, bool bind = true)

method.name: load_file
method.description: Load either a schema or a data file, dispatching on the oks-format info attribute.

method-implementation.prototype: OksFile * load_file(const std::string& name, bool bind = true)

method.name: update_repository
method.description: Check the configuration repository out at a version selector of type hash, tag or date.

method-implementation.prototype: void update_repository(const std::string& param, const std::string& val, RepositoryUpdateType update_type)

method.name: get_repository_versions_by_hash
method.description: List repository versions between two commit hashes. Backs the run/revision resolver.

method-implementation.prototype: std::vector<OksRepositoryVersion> get_repository_versions_by_hash(bool skip_irrelevant = true, const std::string& sha1 = "", const std::string& sha2 = "")

method.name: get_repository_versions_by_date
method.description: List repository versions in a date interval.

method-implementation.prototype: std::vector<OksRepositoryVersion> get_repository_versions_by_date(bool skip_irrelevant = true, const std::string& since = "", const std::string& until = "")

method.name: get_repository_versions_diff
method.description: Files that differ between two repository revisions. Backs revision diff/comparison.

method-implementation.prototype: std::list<std::string> get_repository_versions_diff(const std::string& sha1, const std::string& sha2)

method.name: bind_objects
method.description: Resolve every relationship reference; get_bind_objects_status() returns a non-empty string when references dangle.

method-implementation.prototype: void bind_objects()

class.name: OksFile
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/file.hpp). One OKS XML file on disk: its info header, its include list, its lock state and its repository provenance. get_oks_format() returns schema, data, extended or compact.

attribute.name: short_file_name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_short_file_name(): the path as written in the include directive.

attribute.name: full_file_name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_full_file_name(): the resolved absolute path.

attribute.name: oks_format
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_oks_format(). 'compact' is the default save format; 'extended' writes explicit <attr name type val> tags.

attribute.name: number_of_items
attribute.description: C++ long get_number_of_items(): the num-of-items info attribute.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: C++ enum Mode.

attribute.name: status_of_file
attribute.description: C++ enum FileStatus get_status_of_file().

attribute.name: is_repository_file
attribute.description: C++ bool. GlobalRepository when the file sits under TDAQ_DB_REPOSITORY, UserRepository under TDAQ_DB_USER_REPOSITORY, otherwise NoneRepository.

attribute.name: created_by
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_created_by(): the created-by info attribute.

attribute.name: last_modified_by
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_last_modified_by().

attribute.name: include_files
attribute.description: C++ std::list<std::string> get_include_files(): the <include><file path=.../> entries.

relationship.name: Parent
relationship.description: get_parent(): the file that included this one.

method.name: add_include_file
method.description: Add an include directive, which is how a site schema builds on a shared core schema.

method-implementation.prototype: void add_include_file(const std::string& name)

class.name: OksClass
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/class.hpp). The runtime reflection of one schema class: its inheritance closure, its direct and inherited attributes and relationships, its object map, and execute_query(), the entry point that runs an OksQuery.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_name().

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_description(). This is the text the schema retriever embeds.

attribute.name: is_abstract
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_abstract(). An abstract class holds no direct objects, so it is never a valid target for a query that must return instances.

attribute.name: number_of_objects
attribute.description: C++ size_t number_of_objects().

attribute.name: change_type
attribute.description: C++ enum ChangeType, delivered to subscribe_change_class() callbacks.

relationship.name: Kernel
relationship.description: get_kernel(): the owning OksKernel.

relationship.name: File
relationship.description: get_file(): the schema file that defines this class.

relationship.name: SuperClasses
relationship.description: all_super_classes() / direct_super_classes(). OKS supports multiple inheritance.

relationship.name: SubClasses
relationship.description: all_sub_classes(): the set scanned when a query uses scope 'all'.

relationship.name: Attributes
relationship.description: all_attributes() / direct_attributes().

relationship.name: Relationships
relationship.description: all_relationships() / direct_relationships().

relationship.name: Methods
relationship.description: all_methods() / direct_methods().

relationship.name: Objects
relationship.description: objects(): the instances of this class.

relationship.name: Indices
relationship.description: The OksIndex objects built over this class's attributes; execute_query() prefers an indexed lookup when one matches the comparator.

method.name: execute_query
method.description: Run a query over this class, and over its subclasses when the query has search_in_subclasses() set. Checks CheckSyntax() first, uses an OksIndex when the comparator attribute is indexed, otherwise scans linearly calling OksObject::SatisfiesQueryExpression. Throws oks::QueryFailed.

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject::List * execute_query(OksQuery * query) const

method.name: find_attribute
method.description: Resolve an attribute name over the inheritance closure. Returning nullptr is what makes a generated attribute name invalid.

method-implementation.prototype: OksAttribute * find_attribute(const std::string& name) const noexcept

method.name: find_relationship
method.description: Resolve a relationship name over the inheritance closure. The query parser calls this to type the nested expression of a relationship term.

method-implementation.prototype: OksRelationship * find_relationship(const std::string& name) const noexcept

method.name: get_object
method.description: Direct object lookup by id, without building a query. This is the cheap path when the exact object id is already known.

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject * get_object(const std::string& id) const noexcept

class.name: OksAttribute
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/attribute.hpp). One typed field of a class, with range, format, multi-value, init-value and nullability metadata. Every value constraint the query validator enforces comes from here.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_name().

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_description().

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_type(); OksData::Type get_data_type(). This is the DTD type enumeration and it decides whether a comparison is numeric or lexicographic.

attribute.name: range
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_range(). Notation 'A,B,C..D,*..F,G..*': literals, closed intervals, open-below and open-above. Spaces are not allowed. An enum attribute must have a non-empty range; bool has the predefined range true,false.

attribute.name: format
attribute.description: C++ enum Format { Oct = 8, Dec = 10, Hex = 16 }.

attribute.name: is_multi_value
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_multi_values(). A multi-value attribute holds a list, so a comparison tests the elements.

attribute.name: init_value
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_init_value(); std::list<std::string> get_init_values() for multi-value. Objects that store no value are evaluated against this.

attribute.name: is_not_null
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_no_null().

attribute.name: ordered
attribute.description: C++ bool. Collection ordering for multi-value attributes.

relationship.name: Class
relationship.description: The class that declares this attribute; OksClass::source_class(attr) resolves it through inheritance.

method.name: get_enum_index
method.description: Position of an enumerator inside the range, or -1. Used to validate an enum value before it reaches the query string.

method-implementation.prototype: int get_enum_index(const std::string&) const noexcept

method.name: constructor
method.description: The full constructor used by every oks_utils example, e.g. OksAttribute a("Max Speed", OksAttribute::u16_int_type, false, "", "160", "max speed of car (km/h)", true).

method-implementation.prototype: OksAttribute(const std::string& name, const std::string& type, bool is_mv, const std::string& range, const std::string& init_v, const std::string& description, bool no_null, Format format = Dec, OksClass * p = nullptr)

class.name: OksRelationship
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/relationship.hpp). A typed reference from one object to one or many others. A relationship is either a general (weak) reference or a composite (strong) one; a composite reference may be exclusive or shared, and dependent or independent. Deleting every composite parent deletes a dependent child.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_name().

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_description().

attribute.name: class_type
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_type(); OksClass * get_class_type(). The class of the referenced objects, and therefore the class against which a nested relationship expression is parsed.

attribute.name: low_cardinality_constraint
attribute.description: C++ enum CardinalityConstraint { Zero, One, Many }, low end.

attribute.name: high_cardinality_constraint
attribute.description: C++ enum CardinalityConstraint, high end. 'Many' is what makes the some/all quantifier meaningful.

attribute.name: is_composite
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_composite(). A composite (strong) reference owns its target.

attribute.name: is_exclusive
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_exclusive(). An exclusive component belongs to exactly one composite parent.

attribute.name: is_dependent
attribute.description: C++ bool get_is_dependent(). A dependent child is destroyed with its last composite parent.

attribute.name: ordered
attribute.description: C++ bool. Whether the reference list preserves order.

relationship.name: Class
relationship.description: The class that declares this relationship.

relationship.name: TargetClass
relationship.description: get_class_type() resolved to the referenced OksClass.

method.name: constructor
method.description: Example from oks_utils/examples/relationship.cpp: OksRelationship r("consists of", "Element", OksRelationship::Zero, OksRelationship::Many, true, true, true, false, "A structure consists of zero or many elements").

method-implementation.prototype: OksRelationship(const std::string& name, const std::string& type, CardinalityConstraint low_cc, CardinalityConstraint high_cc, bool composite, bool exclusive, bool dependent, const std::string& description, OksClass * p = nullptr)

class.name: OksMethod
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/method.hpp). A named algorithm attached to a schema class, carrying one implementation per language. DAL generates typed accessors from these.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_name().

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: C++ std::string get_description().

relationship.name: Implementations
relationship.description: One entry per language.

method.name: add_implementation
method.description: Example from oks_utils/examples/method.cpp: m.add_implementation("c++", "void print(const char * s)", "std::cout << s << std::endl;").

method-implementation.prototype: void add_implementation(const std::string& language, const std::string& prototype, const std::string& body)

class.name: OksMethodImplementation
class.description: C++ API. One language binding of an OksMethod; serialised as the <method-implementation> element of the schema DTD.

attribute.name: language
attribute.description: C++ std::string, e.g. c++, c, java.

attribute.name: prototype
attribute.description: C++ std::string: the declaration.

attribute.name: body
attribute.description: C++ std::string: the implementation text.

class.name: OksObject
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/object.hpp). One instance: a class, a unique object id, attribute values and relationship references. SatisfiesQueryExpression() is the per-object predicate the query engine evaluates, and find_path() runs a path query.

attribute.name: id
attribute.description: C++ std::string GetId(). The object id compared by the (object-id "ID" =) query term. An id lookup is cheaper than a non-indexed attribute scan and works for objects with no searchable attributes.

attribute.name: int32_id
attribute.description: C++ int32_t get_int32_id(): the optional numeric alias.

relationship.name: Class
relationship.description: GetClass(): the class this object instantiates.

relationship.name: File
relationship.description: get_file(): the data file that stores this object.

relationship.name: AttributeValues
relationship.description: GetAttributeValue(name) returns the OksData held for each attribute.

relationship.name: ReverseCompositeRels
relationship.description: reverse_composite_rels(): the OksRCR entries naming every composite parent of this object.

method.name: SatisfiesQueryExpression
method.description: Evaluate one query expression against this object. For a comparator with a nil attribute it compares OksData(GetId()), which is how object-id terms work. For a relationship term it walks the reference list; check-all-objects true means every target must match, false means at least one must.

method-implementation.prototype: bool SatisfiesQueryExpression(OksQueryExpression * query_exp) const

method.name: find_path
method.description: Run a path query from this object; returns the list of objects between the start and the destination, or 0 when no path exists.

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject::List * find_path(const QueryPath& query) const

method.name: GetAttributeValue
method.description: Read one attribute value. Object lookup plus this call is the no-query path for a question that already names an exact object id.

method-implementation.prototype: OksData * GetAttributeValue(const std::string& name) const

method.name: GetRelationshipValue
method.description: Read the references held by one relationship. This is relationship navigation: start at an object, follow a named link, land on the target.

method-implementation.prototype: OksData * GetRelationshipValue(const std::string&) const

method.name: SetAttributeValue
method.description: Write one attribute value. Writes belong behind the policy layer, never on the read path.

method-implementation.prototype: void SetAttributeValue(const std::string& name, OksData * data)

method.name: references
method.description: Collect the objects reachable from this one up to a recursion depth, optionally filtered by class.

method-implementation.prototype: void references(OksObject::FSet& refs, unsigned long recursion_depth, bool add_self = false, ClassSet * classes = 0) const

class.name: OksData
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/object.hpp). A discriminated runtime value. Query comparators compare OksData against OksData, which is why a query string writes every value as a quoted token and lets the attribute's type decide the comparison.

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: C++ enum OksData::Type.

attribute.name: value
attribute.description: C++ union payload, rendered by str().

method.name: SetValues
method.description: Parse a textual value into this OksData using an attribute's type and range. The parser calls it for every non-regex comparator.

method-implementation.prototype: void SetValues(const char * s, const OksAttribute * a)

method.name: check_range
method.description: Validate the held value against the attribute range.

method-implementation.prototype: void check_range(const OksAttribute * a) const

class.name: OksIndex
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/index.hpp). A sorted multiset of one class's objects keyed on one attribute. OksClass::execute_query() uses it instead of a linear scan when the comparator attribute is indexed, including two-sided lookups for an and/or of two comparators on the same attribute.

attribute.name: attribute_offset
attribute.description: C++ size_t: the data slot the index sorts on.

relationship.name: Class
relationship.description: The indexed class.

relationship.name: Attribute
relationship.description: The indexed attribute.

method.name: FindEqual
method.description: Indexed '=' lookup.

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject::List * FindEqual(OksData * d) const

method.name: FindGreatEqual
method.description: Indexed '>=' lookup, as in oks_utils/examples/index.cpp.

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject::List * FindGreatEqual(OksData * d) const

method.name: FindLessEqualAndGreatEqual
method.description: Indexed closed-interval lookup, used for (and ("A" "lo" >=) ("A" "hi" <=)).

method-implementation.prototype: OksObject::List * FindLessEqualAndGreatEqual(OksData * d1, OksData * d2) const

class.name: OksRepositoryVersion
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/kernel.hpp). One commit of the git-backed configuration repository: the unit a run number resolves to before any query is executed.

attribute.name: commit_hash
attribute.description: C++ std::string m_commit_hash.

attribute.name: user
attribute.description: C++ std::string m_user.

attribute.name: date
attribute.description: C++ std::time_t m_date.

attribute.name: comment
attribute.description: C++ std::string m_comment.

attribute.name: files
attribute.description: C++ std::vector<std::string> m_files: the files this commit touched.

class.name: OksQuery
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/query.hpp). A complete query: a scope flag plus one root expression. It can be built programmatically from expression objects or parsed from a query string; good() reports whether the parse succeeded. Streaming it back out prints the canonical (all|this (<expr>)) form.

attribute.name: search_in_subclasses
attribute.description: C++ bool search_in_subclasses(). True is the 'all' scope token, false is 'this'. This is the OksQuery(bool b, ...) first constructor argument.

attribute.name: status
attribute.description: C++ int p_status, surfaced by good(). Non-zero means the string failed to parse and the query must not be executed.

attribute.name: query_type
attribute.description: C++ enum QueryType, the tag on every expression node.

attribute.name: reserved_tokens
attribute.description: C++ static const char * members: OR="or", AND="and", NOT="not", SOME="some", THIS_CLASS="this", ALL_SUBCLASSES="all", OID="object-id", PATH_TO="path-to", DIRECT="direct", NESTED="nested". These are the only structural keywords in the grammar.

attribute.name: comparators
attribute.description: C++ static comparator function pointers: equal_cmp '=', not_equal_cmp '!=', reg_exp_cmp '~=', less_or_equal_cmp '<=', greater_or_equal_cmp '>=', less_cmp '<', greater_cmp '>'. reg_exp_cmp uses boost::regex_match, so '~=' matches the whole value.

relationship.name: Expression
relationship.description: get()/set(): the single root expression. The parser rejects a query whose first token is neither 'all' nor 'this'.

method.name: parse_constructor
method.description: Parse a query string against a class. Every attribute, relationship and enum value in the string is resolved through that class, so an unknown name fails here rather than at execution time.

method-implementation.prototype: OksQuery(const OksClass * c, const std::string& query_string)

method.name: build_constructor
method.description: Build a query from an already-constructed expression tree, e.g. OksQuery q(false, new OksComparator(a, new OksData((unsigned short)200), OksQuery::greater_cmp)).

method-implementation.prototype: OksQuery(bool search_in_subclasses, OksQueryExpression * q = 0)

method.name: good
method.description: Whether the query parsed. oks_dump checks q->good() before calling execute_query and exits with code 3 when it is false.

method-implementation.prototype: bool good() const

class.name: OksQueryExpression
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/query.hpp). The abstract base of every query node. CheckSyntax() enforces the structural rules the IR validator mirrors: and/or need two or more operands, not needs exactly one, a relationship node needs a nested expression.

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: C++ OksQuery::QueryType type().

method.name: CheckSyntax
method.description: Structural validation of the node and its children. OksClass::execute_query refuses to run when it returns false.

method-implementation.prototype: bool CheckSyntax() const

class.name: OksComparator
class.description: C++ API. The leaf node of the grammar: an attribute, a value and a comparator function. Serialises as ("attr-name" "value" op). When the attribute pointer is null the node is an object-id test and serialises as (object-id "ID" =).

attribute.name: comparator_function
attribute.description: C++ OksQuery::Comparator: one of equal_cmp, not_equal_cmp, reg_exp_cmp, less_cmp, less_or_equal_cmp, greater_cmp, greater_or_equal_cmp.

attribute.name: is_object_id_test
attribute.description: Derived: true when GetAttribute() is null, i.e. the node compares the object id instead of an attribute.

relationship.name: Base
relationship.description: Derives from OksQueryExpression with type comparator_type.

relationship.name: Attribute
relationship.description: GetAttribute(): the attribute under test, or null for an object-id test.

relationship.name: Value
relationship.description: GetValue(): the OksData compared against. For '~=' it is held as string_type and lazily compiled into a boost::regex.

method.name: constructor
method.description: Example from oks_utils/examples/comparator.cpp: OksComparator qc(&a, new OksData("Peter"), OksQuery::equal_cmp).

method-implementation.prototype: OksComparator(const OksAttribute * a, OksData * v, OksQuery::Comparator f)

class.name: OksRelationshipExpression
class.description: C++ API. A relationship term: follow a named relationship and evaluate the nested expression on the referenced objects. Serialises as ("rel-name" some <expr>) or ("rel-name" all <expr>). The parser types the nested expression against the relationship's target class.

attribute.name: is_check_all_objects
attribute.description: C++ bool IsCheckAllObjects(). True is the 'all' quantifier (every referenced object must satisfy the nested expression); false is 'some' (at least one must).

relationship.name: Base
relationship.description: Derives from OksQueryExpression with type relationship_type.

relationship.name: Relationship
relationship.description: GetRelationship(): the link that is followed.

relationship.name: NestedExpression
relationship.description: get(): the expression evaluated on each referenced object, not on the original one.

method.name: constructor
method.description: Example from oks_utils/examples/r_expression.cpp: OksRelationshipExpression rqe(&r, new OksComparator(&a, new OksData("BMW"), OksQuery::equal_cmp), false).

method-implementation.prototype: OksRelationshipExpression(const OksRelationship * r, OksQueryExpression * q, bool check_all_objects = false)

class.name: OksNotExpression
class.description: C++ API. Logical negation. Serialises as (not <expr>) and takes exactly one operand; the parser rejects any other count.

relationship.name: Base
relationship.description: Derives from OksQueryExpression with type not_type.

relationship.name: Operand
relationship.description: get(): the single negated expression.

method.name: constructor
method.description: Example from oks_utils/examples/not_expression.cpp: OksNotExpression ne(new OksComparator(&a, new OksData((unsigned short)25), OksQuery::less_cmp)).

method-implementation.prototype: OksNotExpression(OksQueryExpression * q = 0)

class.name: OksListBaseQueryExpression
class.description: C++ API. The shared operand list behind the and/or nodes.

relationship.name: Operands
relationship.description: expressions(): the operand list; add() appends.

class.name: OksAndExpression
class.description: C++ API. Logical conjunction, serialised as (and e1 e2 ...). The parser requires two or more operands. Example from oks_utils/examples/and_expression.cpp: a closed interval 60 <= weight <= 90 built from a greater_or_equal_cmp and a less_or_equal_cmp on the same attribute.

relationship.name: Base
relationship.description: Derives from OksQueryExpression with type and_type.

relationship.name: OperandList
relationship.description: Derives from OksListBaseQueryExpression.

class.name: OksOrExpression
class.description: C++ API. Logical disjunction, serialised as (or e1 e2 ...). The parser requires two or more operands. Example from oks_utils/examples/or_expression.cpp: tall or short, two comparators on the same float attribute.

relationship.name: Base
relationship.description: Derives from OksQueryExpression with type or_type.

relationship.name: OperandList
relationship.description: Derives from OksListBaseQueryExpression.

class.name: QueryPath
class.description: C++ API (oks::QueryPath, include/oks/query.hpp). A path query: (path-to "id@class" <path-expression>). The destination is written id@class and must resolve to a loaded object; an unparseable path throws oks::bad_query_syntax. Path queries describe topology and are not attribute filters, which is why the IR used by the translator cannot express them today.

attribute.name: destination
attribute.description: C++: parsed out of the quoted "object-id@class-name" token; the class is resolved with kernel.find_class() and the object with OksClass::get_object().

relationship.name: GoalObject
relationship.description: get_goal_object(): the object the path must reach.

relationship.name: StartExpression
relationship.description: get_start_expression(): the first (direct ...) or (nested ...) step.

method.name: constructor
method.description: Parse a path query. Example: (path-to "my-id@my-class" (direct "A" "B" (nested "N" (direct "X" "Y" "Z")))).

method-implementation.prototype: QueryPath(const std::string& query, const OksKernel& kernel)

class.name: QueryPathExpression
class.description: C++ API. One step of a path query: a traversal mode plus a list of quoted relationship names plus an optional next step. 'direct' follows the named relationships once; 'nested' looks through recursively nested objects. Relationship names must be quoted.

attribute.name: use_nested_lookup
attribute.description: C++ bool get_use_nested_lookup(): true for the 'nested' keyword, false for 'direct'.

attribute.name: rel_names
attribute.description: C++ std::list<std::string> get_rel_names(): the relationships followed at this step.

relationship.name: Next
relationship.description: get_next(): the nested step, which is what makes a path query multi-level.

class.name: OksException
class.description: C++ API (include/oks/exceptions.hpp and query.hpp). The failure taxonomy a generated query can hit. Each value maps to a distinct repair action, which is why the error breakdown is reported per category rather than as a single pass/fail number.

attribute.name: kind
attribute.description: C++ exception types thrown on the query path.

attribute.name: oks_dump_exit_code
attribute.description: Exit status of the oks_dump validation oracle: 0 success, 1 bad command line, 2 bad OKS file, 3 bad query, 4 no such class, 5 dangling references, 6 exception caught.

attribute.name: what
attribute.description: C++ const char * what().
